text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Sound interest in Malta as a cruise liner base. Malta seeks to establish itself as base for cruise liners in Mediterranean. Economic Services Minister Josef Bonnici said two or three solid queries had been made by cruise lines wishing to base themselves in Malta.
- Italian minesweepers helping detect wreckage of wartime aircraft in the sea. Some aircaft are being lifted and restored for an aviation museum.
- Tourism expected to drop by 10 percent by end of the year.
- A Briton and a Maltese jailed for drug trafficking.

- Education is key for greater democracy, prime minister says. Eddie Fenech Adami was speaking at activities being held by the ruling Nationalist Party to mark the 32nd anniversary of Malta's independence.
